column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the zap-baseline job in security.yml:
# <rule id><TAB><FAIL|WARN|IGNORE><TAB>(name). FAIL fails the job; the job
# passes -I, so WARN stays advisory. The scan targets `vite preview` of the
# built dist/, which serves no headers of its own; GitHub Pages can't set
# headers either, so the CSP is a meta tag (vite.config.ts).
# FAIL: what the app's own files control.

column3: (Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set: ZAP reads the meta tag too)

column1: # WARN: reported for review, not blocking.

column3: (CSP: notes on the policy, such as style-src 'unsafe-inline')
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: matches words in bundled libraries)

column1: # IGNORE: response headers GitHub Pages decides, not this repo.

column3: (Missing Anti-clickjacking Header: frame-ancestors can't be set in a meta CSP)
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: Pages sends it; vite preview doesn't)
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set: needs a response header)
(Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre Vulnerability: needs COOP/COEP headers)
(Sec-Fetch-* headers missing: request headers, sent by browsers)
